description: Development evaluation cases for the fictional HR RAG assistant.

cases.question: How do I submit my new-hire paperwork?
expected_points: Sign in to the approved HR portal.
Open the onboarding checklist.
Upload or complete each requested item and confirm its status.
must_not_claim: An invented portal URL or submission deadline.

cases.question: How do I enroll in benefits?
expected_points: Open the secure benefits portal.
Review plan summaries and dependent eligibility.
Compare coverage and payroll deductions.
Select plans, add eligible dependents if applicable, and save the confirmation receipt.
must_not_claim: An invented enrollment deadline, benefit cost, or portal URL.

cases.question: I watched the training video but skipped its required assessment. Can I mark the course complete?
expected_points: Watching the video alone is not sufficient when an assessment is required.
Finish the course and required assessment.
Verify that the LMS shows Completed.
must_not_claim: The employee has completed the training.
A passing score not specified in the corpus.

cases.question: My LMS account is not working and my training is due tomorrow. What should I do?
expected_points: Report the account or access problem to the IT service desk.
Notify the manager and learning administrator before the due date if possible.
must_not_claim: The training can be marked complete.

cases.question: How many days after my start date do I have to enroll in benefits?
expected_points: The sample knowledge base does not specify a universal enrollment deadline.
Use the exact deadline shown in the benefits portal or welcome materials.
must_not_claim: A fixed number of enrollment days.

cases.question: Has my direct-deposit change been approved?
expected_points: The supplied documents do not establish the employee's approval status.
Direct the employee to Payroll or the authoritative system to check.
must_not_claim: The change is approved, pending, or rejected.
An invented payroll contact or processing time.

cases.question: Where do I submit it?
expected_points: Ask which item or document the employee wants to submit.
Do not choose one submission destination without clarification.
must_not_claim: A definitive submission destination for the unspecified item.

cases.question: Who should I contact about payroll?
expected_points: Direct payroll questions to Payroll.
Payroll handles pay dates, tax withholding, and direct deposit.
must_not_claim: An invented person's name, email address, or phone number.
